title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B RepeatM Lane-Source Diagnostic
command: Apply a tmp-only VDCores diagnostic patch on the H200 baseline checkout, rebuild with DAE_DIAG_REPEAT_LANES, DAE_DIAG_WAIT_AFTER_WB_ALLOC, and DAE_DIAG_USE_SPLIT_U64_SHUFFLE, then run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 QWEN1P7B_NO_PREFETCH=all QWEN1P7B_LOGITS_SPLIT_M=6 python app/python/qwen3_1p7b/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache> --debug-num-layers 1 --debug-stop-after logits -N 1 --launch.
observation: The RepeatM lane-source diagnostic rebuilt on H200 and launched the one-layer logits path. Forcing split 32-bit shuffles for the 64-bit RepeatM accumulator avoids the earlier pc50 desc33 coordinate mutation, but native and split shuffle values disagree across lanes for the same source lane and pc52 then mutates desc32 coordinates to (0,12544,3), ending with illegal memory access.
blocker: VDCores still cannot import queue/resource-policy timing. The writeback-slot lifetime hazard is reduced, but the RepeatM hazard is not a simple uint64 shuffle lowering bug. The next diagnostic must instrument active masks, producer-lane ownership, source-lane validity, and packed coordinate-delta lifetime without changing the runtime's addr_accum semantics.

rules_out: slot metadata lifetime as the only remaining logits-stage blocker
a simple uint64 native-shuffle lowering bug as the sole root cause
the previous pc50 desc33 invalid coordinate as the only RepeatM hazard
summary.next_debug_target: instrument RepeatM active masks, source-lane ownership, and packed coordinate-delta lifecycle without changing addr_accum semantics; the next probe should print producer lanes and only inspect repeat opcodes
